theorems.name: Submission.cmcdtfrbv_face_covectors
theorems.statement: ∀ (P m : ℕ) (ι : Fin (m + 1) → Fin P), StrictMono ι → ∃ ε : Fin (m + 1) → Covector (Euclid P) m, (∀ c : Fin (m + 1) → ℝ, covectorEuclideanNorm (∑ j, c j • ε j) = Real.sqrt (∑ j, c j ^ 2)) ∧ ∀ (c : Fin (m + 1) → ℝ) (j : Fin (m + 1)), (∑ j', c j' • ε j') (fun k => EuclideanSpace.single (ι (j.succAbove k)) (1 : ℝ)) = (-1) ^ (j : ℕ) * c j
